station_name: Sacramento River at Butte City, Calif.
notes: Monthly summary table with its own dates: rows June 16-30, July, August, September of the year ending September 30, 1923, so those are used instead of the full water year. Maximum, minimum, mean x 4 rows = 12 measurements. Run-off in acre-feet (4 rows + The period) = 5 summary values, only in n_variables. No coordinates, station number or county printed for this station (Colusa County on the page belongs to the next station, Sacramento River at Colusa).
